RESTORE 50000
READ a%,b&,x,y,z:PRINT ;a%;":";b&;":";x;":";y;":";z
PRINT ;?(^x+4);":";?(^y+4);":";?(^z+4)
READ s$,t$,u$,v$,w$:PRINT ;LEN s$;":";s$;":";t$;":";u$;":";v$;":";LEN w$
RESTORE:READ a%:PRINT ;a%:RESTORE 50010:READ s$:PRINT s$
END
50000 DATA -123,257,1.0,1E-3,&FFFFFFFF
50010 DATA "leading and trailing  ","a,b:c","a""b", 123  ,""
